title: What to Wear in Goa: A Vacation Outfit Guide for Women
seoTitle: What to Wear in Goa: Vacation Outfits for Women (Packing List)
seoDescription: Exactly what to pack for Goa — breezy dresses, crochet tops, co-ords and layers for beach days, cafés and nights out, plus a 5-day capsule packing list.
excerpt: Beach days, café hopping and sunset dinners — here’s exactly what to pack for Goa, with a 5-day capsule that mixes and matches.
bodyHtml:
What should you wear in Goa? Pack breathable cotton and rayon dresses, a crochet or halter top with shorts, one co-ord set you can split into separate outfits, a light shirt for breezy evenings, and flat sandals. Keep to one colour palette so every piece mixes and matches — eight to ten pieces cover a five-day trip.

Goa weather, and why fabric matters

Goa is warm and humid for most of the year, with the most comfortable beach weather between November and February and heavy rain from June to September. That makes fabric your first decision: natural, breathable fibres like cotton, cotton slub and rayon keep you cooler than synthetics, and relaxed silhouettes let air move.

The 5-day Goa capsule (10 pieces)

  1. A tiered or wrap dress for café mornings — try the Sunny Daisy Swiss-dot wrap dress.
  2. A dress for dinners — something with a little drama, like the schiffli-embroidered tiered midi.
  3. A co-ord set — three outfits in one; the mustard print co-ord works as a set, or split.
  4. A crochet top — the floral crochet lace-up top with shorts is peak beach-shack.
  5. A halter top for sunset — shoulders out, sea breeze in.
  6. An embroidered skirt to wear with either top.
  7. Denim shorts.
  8. A light shirt — the checkered yoke denim shirt layers over everything.
  9. Swimwear and a cover-up.
  10. Flat sandals and white sneakers.

Outfits for every Goa plan

Beach day

Swimwear, a crochet top or loose shirt as a cover-up, shorts and flat sandals. Add a straw hat and sunglasses — the sun is strong even when it’s breezy.

Café hopping in Assagao or Panjim

A cotton wrap or fit-and-flare dress with sneakers. Latin Quarter walks in Fontainhas mean lots of steps, so keep your shoes comfortable.

Sunset and dinner

A tiered midi dress or a co-ord with block heels or dressy sandals, plus statement earrings. Carry the light shirt — beach evenings can get windy.

Flea markets and road trips

Co-ord shorts with a crochet top and a crossbody bag to keep your hands free.

Packing tips that save space

  • Roll clothes instead of folding them to reduce creases.
  • Pick prints — they hide wrinkles and sand.
  • Keep crochet and embroidered pieces on top so the detailing stays crisp.
  • Pack one outfit in your carry-on in case checked bags are delayed.

Frequently asked questions

What should I not wear in Goa?

Avoid heavy denim, dark synthetic fabrics and anything that needs ironing. Dress more modestly — covered shoulders and knees — when visiting churches and temples.

Is it okay to wear shorts in Goa?

Yes, shorts and short dresses are common in beach areas. Carry a light layer for religious sites and local markets.

What should I wear in Goa in December?

December is peak season with warm days and slightly cooler evenings: summer dresses and co-ords by day, plus a light shirt or shrug for the night.

title: What Is Schiffli Embroidery? How to Wear and Care for It
seoTitle: What Is Schiffli Embroidery? Meaning, Styling & Care Guide
seoDescription: Schiffli embroidery explained — what it is, how it differs from chikankari and hakoba, how to style schiffli dresses and jumpsuits, and how to wash them.
excerpt: The delicate eyelets and scalloped edges on your favourite summer dress have a name. Here’s what schiffli is, how to style it and how to keep it looking new.
bodyHtml:
What is schiffli embroidery? Schiffli is a type of machine embroidery, named after the boat-shaped (Swiss-German “schiffli”) shuttle of the looms that stitch it. It creates dense floral motifs, eyelets and scalloped edges directly on fabric — usually cotton — giving a delicate, lace-like finish that is light and breathable.

Where schiffli comes from

Schiffli machines were developed in Switzerland in the 19th century to embroider long lengths of fabric at once. In India, schiffli cotton is widely loved for summer clothing because it adds texture and detail without adding weight — you may also hear eyelet-embroidered cotton called hakoba.

Schiffli vs chikankari vs crochet

SchiffliChikankariCrochet lace
How it’s madeMulti-needle embroidery machineHand embroidery (Lucknow)Looped thread, by hook or machine
LookEyelets, scallops, dense floralsFine white-on-white stitchesOpen, textured lace
Best forSummer dresses, jumpsuits, topsKurtas, festive wearTrims, tops, beachwear

How to style schiffli

  • Keep the rest simple. Schiffli is the statement — pair it with solid colours and minimal jewellery.
  • Day: a scalloped schiffli jumpsuit with sneakers.
  • Brunch: a schiffli-trimmed flared skirt with a plain tank.
  • Evening: the schiffli tiered midi dress with heeled sandals.
  • Layered: a check shirt with schiffli embroidery over a slip dress.

How to wash schiffli clothes

  1. Turn the garment inside out.
  2. Hand wash or use a gentle cycle in cold water with a mild detergent.
  3. Don’t wring — press water out gently so eyelets keep their shape.
  4. Dry in the shade; direct sun can fade coloured threads.
  5. Iron on the reverse on a medium setting, placing a cloth over the embroidery.

Frequently asked questions

Is schiffli fabric see-through?

Eyelets can be slightly sheer. Many schiffli pieces are lined or use embroidery on panels and hems — check the product description.

Is schiffli good for summer?

Yes. It’s usually embroidered on cotton, so it stays breathable, and the eyelets add airflow.

title: How to Style a Crochet Top: 7 Easy Outfits
seoTitle: How to Style a Crochet Top: 7 Outfit Ideas for Every Plan
seoDescription: Seven easy ways to style a crochet top — with jeans, skirts, shorts, co-ords and for the office — plus what to wear underneath and how to care for crochet.
excerpt: From beach to boardroom: seven outfits built around one crochet top, plus what to wear under it and how to keep the lace looking new.
bodyHtml:
How do you style a crochet top? Balance its texture with simple, solid pieces: high-waisted jeans or shorts for casual days, a flowy skirt for brunch, tailored trousers and a blazer for work. Wear a nude or matching camisole underneath if the crochet is open, and finish with natural accessories like straw, wood or silver.

7 ways to wear a crochet top

1. With high-waisted denim

The easiest formula: a crochet top, straight-leg jeans and white sneakers. Try it with the floral crochet lace-up top.

2. With a flowy midi skirt

Tuck a fitted crochet-accent top into a tiered or flared skirt for a romantic brunch look.

3. With shorts for the beach

Over swimwear or with denim shorts — crochet was made for sea breezes. See our vacation edit.

4. Under a blazer for work

A crochet-trimmed top like the square-neck crochet accent top under a blazer, with tailored trousers, adds personality to office wear.

5. With a mini skirt for nights out

Add block heels and statement earrings.

6. Layered with a denim shirt

Wear a shirt open over the top on cooler evenings — the checkered yoke denim shirt works perfectly.

7. With co-ord bottoms

Borrow the shorts or pants from a co-ord set for a new outfit without buying anything else.

What to wear under a crochet top

Choose a seamless camisole or bralette in a nude, matching or contrasting colour. Trumee crochet tops use crochet as trims and panels on solid bases, so most can be worn on their own.

How to care for crochet

Hand wash in cold water, don’t wring, and dry flat in the shade to keep the lace from stretching.

title: How to Style a Co-ord Set: 5 Outfits from One Set
seoTitle: How to Style a Co-ord Set: 5 Outfits From One Set (Women)
seoDescription: One co-ord set, five outfits. How to wear a matching set together, split it up, layer it and dress it up or down — with shoes and accessories for each look.
excerpt: A co-ord set is really three pieces of clothing — here’s how to turn one set into five different outfits.
bodyHtml:
How do you style a co-ord set? Wear it together for an instant outfit, then split it: pair the top with jeans or a skirt, and the bottoms with a plain tee or tank. Change the look with shoes and layers — sneakers for day, heels or sandals for evening, a denim shirt for cooler nights.

1. Wear it together, keep it simple

Let the print do the work. With the mustard artistic print co-ord, add white sneakers and a small crossbody bag.

2. Dress it up for dinner

Swap sneakers for block heels, add gold hoops and tuck the shirt in. Relaxed co-ords like the embroidered olive co-ord look polished with just one statement accessory.

3. The shirt as a layer

Wear the co-ord shirt open over a black tank with denim — or over a slip dress like the floral fit-and-flare dress.

4. The bottoms with a crochet top

Keep the shorts or pants, swap the shirt for a textured top such as the crochet accent square-neck top.

5. The travel uniform

Co-ords pack flat and mix with everything, which is why they anchor our vacation edit. One set plus two tops gives you at least four outfits.

Frequently asked questions

Can short women wear co-ord sets?

Yes — choose high-waisted bottoms, tuck the top in and match your shoes to the set’s colour to lengthen the line.

Are co-ord sets still in fashion?

Matching sets remain a staple because they’re effortless and versatile; prints and craft details like crochet keep them fresh.

title: What to Wear in the Hills in Summer: Manali, Rishikesh & Mussoorie
seoTitle: What to Wear in the Hills in Summer (Manali, Rishikesh): Outfit Guide
seoDescription: Warm days, cool evenings: what to pack for a summer hill-station trip — layers, dresses, jumpsuits and shoes for Manali, Rishikesh, Mussoorie and Shimla.
excerpt: Hill stations in summer swing from sunny afternoons to chilly evenings. Pack in layers with this simple outfit plan.
bodyHtml:
What should you wear in the hills in summer? Dress in layers: breathable cotton dresses, jumpsuits or jeans with tops for warm afternoons, plus a shirt or light jacket for cool mornings and evenings. Choose comfortable walking shoes with grip, and pack one warmer layer for higher altitudes.

The layering formula

  1. Base: a breathable top, dress or jumpsuit.
  2. Mid-layer: a shirt you can open, knot or tie around your waist — like the checkered yoke denim shirt or the hooded check shirt.
  3. Outer layer: a light jacket or shawl for evenings at altitude.

Outfits by plan

Café hopping in Rishikesh or Old Manali

A cotton jumpsuit with sneakers — try the ombre schiffli dungaree jumpsuit — with the denim shirt tied at the waist.

Easy walks and viewpoints

Jeans, a relaxed top and trail-friendly shoes. Skip long trailing hems on rocky paths.

Evenings

A sleeved dress with ankle boots and your shirt or shawl on top — the mustard balloon-sleeve dress is a warm-toned favourite.

What not to pack

  • Heavy pieces you can’t layer
  • Only sleeveless outfits
  • Brand-new shoes you haven’t walked in

Frequently asked questions

Is it cold in Manali in June?

Days are usually pleasant, but mornings, evenings and higher passes can be cold — carry a warm layer.

title: Monsoon Outfit Guide: Fabrics That Dry Fast (and What to Avoid)
seoTitle: Monsoon Outfits for Women: Best Fabrics That Dry Fast
seoDescription: What to wear in the monsoon: quick-dry fabrics, the right hemlines and colours, and monsoon-proof outfit ideas for work, college and weekends.
excerpt: Rain-ready dressing starts with fabric. Here’s what dries fast, which hemlines to choose and how to still look put-together.
bodyHtml:
What should you wear in the monsoon? Choose lightweight fabrics that dry quickly — georgette, rayon and thin cotton — in knee-length or shorter hemlines that stay clear of puddles. Darker colours and prints hide splashes, and closed or waterproof footwear keeps you comfortable.

Best monsoon fabrics

FabricDriesWhy it works
GeorgetteFastVery light, doesn’t cling when damp
RayonMedium-fastCool and soft; easy to wash
Thin cottonMediumBreathable in humidity
Heavy denimSlowStays wet and heavy — avoid

Monsoon outfit ideas

  • Work: a georgette top like the black textured peplum top with cropped trousers.
  • Weekend: a printed dress such as the printed georgette halter dress.
  • College: a ruffle-tiered cotton skirt with a tee and waterproof sandals.

Care tips for the rainy season

Dry clothes indoors with a fan, never leave damp clothes folded, and store embroidered pieces with silica packets.

Frequently asked questions

Which colours are best for the monsoon?

Deep tones like plum, rust, navy and bottle green, and busy prints, hide mud splashes better than whites and pastels.

title: Office Outfits That Aren’t Boring: 10 Western Looks for Women
seoTitle: Office Wear for Women: 10 Western Office Outfits (Not Boring)
seoDescription: Ten western office outfits for women that feel polished but personal — peplum tops, embroidered shirts, midi dresses and skirts, plus how to style them for work.
excerpt: Work wardrobes don’t have to be beige. Ten polished, personality-packed western looks for the office.
bodyHtml:
What is good office wear for women? Good office wear is polished, comfortable for a full day and suited to your workplace: tailored trousers or midi skirts, structured tops like peplums and button-downs, and knee-to-midi dresses. Add personality through one detail — embroidery, texture or colour — rather than many.

10 looks

  1. Peplum + straight trousers: the black textured peplum top with tailored pants.
  2. Embroidered sleeves + pencil skirt: the embroidered-sleeve button-down.
  3. Wrap dress + blazer: the monochrome floral wrap dress.
  4. Textured top + wide-leg trousers: the georgette burnout top.
  5. Statement red: the scarlet lace-panel top with black trousers.
  6. Utility skirt + fitted tee: the dori-embroidered utility skirt.
  7. Midi dress + loafers: the rust check embroidered dress with a cardigan.
  8. Denim Friday: the checkered yoke denim shirt tucked into black trousers.
  9. Balloon sleeves + belt: the mustard balloon-sleeve dress.
  10. Desk-to-dinner: keep heels and earrings at your desk to switch any look for the evening.

Rules of thumb

  • One statement per outfit.
  • Midi lengths and covered shoulders suit most offices; add a blazer if unsure.
  • Choose breathable fabrics for long commutes.

title: Boho Dresses for Every Body Type: How to Choose Yours
seoTitle: Boho Dresses for Every Body Type: Silhouette Guide for Women
seoDescription: Which boho dress suits your shape? A simple guide to fit-and-flare, wrap, tiered and relaxed silhouettes — plus fabric, length and sizing tips.
excerpt: Wrap, tiered, fit-and-flare or relaxed? A friendly, no-rules guide to finding the boho dress that feels best on you.
bodyHtml:
Which boho dress suits your body type? Fit-and-flare and wrap dresses define the waist and suit most shapes; tiered midis add movement and balance broader shoulders; relaxed, skimming silhouettes are the most comfortable for all-day wear. Choose the waistline and length that make you feel good — there are no hard rules.

Silhouettes at a glance

SilhouetteWhat it doesTry
Fit-and-flareNips the waist, flares over hipsFloral fit-and-flare
WrapAdjustable waist; V-neck lengthensSunny Daisy wrap
Tiered midiMovement and volume at the hemSchiffli tiered midi
Relaxed bohoSkims the body, easy fitHandkerchief-hem dress
SleevedCoverage with dramaBalloon-sleeve dress

If you want to…

  • Define your waist: wrap and fit-and-flare dresses, or belt a relaxed dress.
  • Balance broader shoulders: V-necks and fuller, tiered skirts.
  • Look taller: knee-length hems, V-necks and shoes that match your skin tone or dress.
  • Stay cool in the heat: cotton and rayon in relaxed shapes.

Getting the size right

Measure your bust and waist and compare with our size chart. Between sizes? Size up for relaxed styles; for wrap dresses, go by your bust.
